# Fast.com

> Fast.com is Netflix's simple, free internet speed test tool that measures download speed, upload speed, latency, and bufferbloat across multiple languages and regions.

Fast.com provides a straightforward speed testing experience available in 20+ languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, and more. The tool measures key network metrics including download/upload speeds, ping latency, and bufferbloat detection to help users diagnose connection quality.

## Key Topics

- Internet Speed Test
- Download Speed
- Upload Speed
- Latency & Ping
- Bufferbloat Detection
- Bandwidth Measurement
- Network Diagnostics
- Connection Quality
- Netflix
- Speed Measurement
- Latency Testing
- Ping Test
- Connection Diagnostics

## Core Speed Test

- [Internet Speed Test | Fast.com](https://fast.com): Fast.com homepage: simple internet speed test by Netflix
